pr_title: Change Welcome intro track to loop
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/9390

~~The default setting for this right now is set to `true`.~~
~~This might not be desired for `Triangles` considering the `welcome to osu!` is baked into the beatmap.~~
~~This should be fine for `Circles` and `Welcome` though.~~

This makes the Welcome intro loop on the main menu until a user performs an action like changing the song or entering song select.
pr_comments:
Makes sense.

I made it an option because there could be users that would like the `Welcome` intro but not having it loop. 
Then again it would only make sense for `Welcome` to be looped in the first place. 

I'll update it so only `Welcome` gets looped
Is that how it is back in stable-fallback?

> Is that how it is back in stable-fallback?

Yea it does loop always unless you switch to another song then you can only listen to it again until you restart
